name: Abuja Open 2024

venue.name: Living Fountain International School Citec Mbora district, along Jabi Airport Road, FCT, Abuja
venue.address: Citec Mbora district, along Jabi Airport Road, Federal Capital Territory, Abuja

information: The competition is open to all competitors of all ages and nationalities. Competitors should be willing to volunteer as Judges/Scramblers/Runners during the competition. Description to access the venue: From Gwagwalada board a cab to Lugbe and highlight at Car wash bridge, then board another cab going to airport junction and highlight at Citec's gate, then walk into School.
